note: v3: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase official list). Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, as fine-grained numbered steps; each step names the source it comes from, and most steps are backed by 2+ sources that agree. Where sources disagree, or no source pins a detail down, the trophy is marked disputed and the guide shows both sides instead of guessing. 11 named, dated sources. Theme: each trophy is shown like a prediction-market card — a big chance number, a YES/NO resolve button, a probability bar and an odds table — but the numbers are this guide's own estimates from difficulty and time, not a real market, and no Polymarket or Rockstar logo or artwork is used.

trophies.guide: This pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned; there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the 7-stage roadmap in this guide — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands and the count-based clean-up — and check the tracker here after each session so nothing is left behind. No online play is needed: all 55 trophies are offline, in one playthrough, about 200 hours in total at difficulty 4/10.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.verify: The trophy list itself: 54 of 54 other trophies earned, then this pops at once.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum has no separate task of its own and pops the moment the last one does.
Stage 1-2: play the story first, 60-80 hours, chapters 1-5 in order, before any serious clean-up.
Stage 3: after the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and work the checklist — it is the longest single trophy at about 100 hours.
Stage 4: clear the collectible sets — 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos.
Stage 5: finish the count trophies — 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 50 challenges, 500 Criminal Profile actions, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent.
Stage 6: finish the stranger strands — 8 counting strands plus Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret.
Stage 7: finish the disputed trophies last, checking each against the newest guide, then the platinum pops.
Check the tracker here after each session; no online play is needed and one playthrough is enough.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so just follow the on-screen objectives and the trophy pops when the mission completes. It cannot be missed, and there is no mission replay, so there is nothing to prepare for in advance.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.verify: Mission-complete screen for Gone Fishing; the trophy pops at once.

steps.t: Start the story and play Gone Fishing, Jason's first mission, through to its end.
Follow the on-screen objectives; the trophy pops when the mission completes.
It is automatic and unmissable, so no preparation is needed before starting.
It is the first mission of the game, so it cannot be skipped or locked behind anything.
If it does not pop, finish the mission's final objective — the pop is tied to mission completion, not to a side task.
Official description is simply completing Gone Fishing, so there is no hidden requirement.
After it, keep playing the story in order; Chapter 1 continues straight on.
Tick it off in the tracker here and move on — this is the easiest trophy on the list.

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the first mission of Chapter 2 begins, so keep playing the story in order and do not worry about side content yet — except for one thing in this chapter: do the Lucia balcony meditation described under Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends, because that one interaction is reported as possibly missable.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.verify: Chapter 2's first mission, What's in the Bag?, begins — that is when it pops.

steps.t: Play Chapter 1's main missions in order until the chapter ends.
The trophy pops when the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins, so it is automatic.
Before the chapter ends, do the Lucia balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — the one thing in this chapter that may be missable.
Make a manual save at the start of the chapter: there are 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave, and no mission replay.
Side content in Chapter 1 is optional for this trophy; the chapter missions alone are enough.
Chapter 1 introduces Jason and Lucia and the Leonida map, so use it to learn the controls.
Check the chapter progress in the pause menu if you are unsure how many missions are left.
Once it pops, tick it off here; the next chapter's missions open immediately.

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, this one pops automatically at the end of the chapter, so play the story in order. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay, so a separate save is your only way back if you want to redo a section.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.verify: Chapter 3's first mission, Welcome to Vice City, begins — that is when it pops.

steps.t: Play Chapter 2's main missions in order until the chapter ends.
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 begins, with its first mission Welcome to Vice City, so it is automatic.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter; with 15 manual slots and no mission replay, a save is the only way back.
After the mission Coffee Break in this chapter, you can free-roam and switch between Jason and Lucia.
That switch unlocks the partner trophies Hot Together and Retail Therapy, so try them once the chapter is done.
Chapter 2 also opens the first stranger strands and the fishing questline with Cal.
No side task is required for this trophy; the chapter missions alone are enough.
Tick it off here when it pops and keep the story moving into Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, so keep playing into the next chapter. By now the side activities are opening up across Leonida, so try a new activity type when one appears — that progress counts toward Master of None and toward the 100% checklist later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.verify: The first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, are done — that is when it pops.

steps.t: Play Chapter 3's main missions in order until the chapter ends.
The trophy pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so keep playing past the chapter boundary.
Try a new activity type when one appears; that counts toward Master of None and the 100% checklist.
Chapter 3 unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer after Credit Check, which starts the Marked Bills laundering for Dime on the Dollar.
It also unlocks jewelry store robberies after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, needed for Sneakthief.
Randy's Wish List opens after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in this chapter — scan sports cars with WAiNK from here on.
No side task is required for this trophy; the chapter missions alone are enough.
Tick it off here when it pops; you are roughly halfway through the story.

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 4. It pops after the final mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero. This is also the chapter where the optional mission behind Maximum Withdrawal appears, so watch for the optional bank-job mission in this chapter and take it when it is offered, rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.verify: The final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero, ends — that is when it pops.

steps.t: Play Chapter 4's main missions in order until the chapter ends.
The trophy pops after the final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.
Take the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is when it is offered; it unlocks the bank-vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal.
That optional mission also counts toward A Classic Blitz Play, since you tail an armored truck to the bank.
Chapter 4 is where the 4-star wanted levels for Hot Together come naturally, at the large bank vaults.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter; there is still no mission replay.
No other side task is required for this trophy; the chapter missions alone are enough.
Tick it off here when it pops; one chapter of story remains.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It pops when the mission ends and the story closes. After it, the game opens into free roam, so this is the point to switch to clean-up: open Progress, then Stats, then the 100% Completion checklist, and work through what is left.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.verify: The story closes and free roam opens; the trophy pops as the final mission ends.

steps.t: Play the final story mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends and the story closes; it is automatic.
After it, switch to free-roam clean-up: open Progress, then Stats, then the 100% Completion checklist.
Check what already counts: progress made during the story already counts toward the checklist.
Make a manual save right after the story ends, as your clean-up base save.
All stranger strands and side quests stay available in free roam, so nothing story-side is lost.
Use the roadmap in this guide from here: checklist first, then collectibles, then counts, then strangers.
Tick it off here; the story is done and the platinum hunt becomes clean-up.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when that mission ends, as part of the story, so there is no separate task and no way to miss it. If you are tracking the story, tick it off here as soon as it pops and move on to the next mission.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.verify: Breakfast Run's mission-complete screen; the trophy pops at once.

steps.t: Play the story until the Breakfast Run mission appears in Chapter 2.
Complete Breakfast Run; the trophy pops at the end of the mission.
It is automatic and unmissable, so no preparation is needed.
It is a story mission, so it appears in the normal mission order and cannot be skipped.
If it does not pop, finish the mission's final objective — the pop is tied to mission completion.
Official description is simply completing Breakfast Run, so there is no hidden requirement.
After it, the story continues into the Chapter 2 missions that open free-roam switching.
Tick it off here as soon as it pops and move on to the next mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the heist mission ends. Heists are story beats, not repeatable side jobs, so just play the mission through when it appears in the story order.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.verify: The Cartel Heist's mission-complete screen; the trophy pops at once.

steps.t: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears in Chapter 3.
Complete the heist mission; the trophy pops at its end.
It is automatic and unmissable.
Heists are story beats, not repeatable side jobs, so there is no way to redo it — and no need to.
Follow the on-screen objectives; the heist's plan is given to you in the mission.
Official description is simply completing The Cartel Heist, so there is no hidden requirement.
Make a manual save before the mission if you want a clean checkpoint, since there is no mission replay.
Tick it off here as soon as it pops and keep the story moving.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops at the end of that mission, as part of the story. No preparation is needed; the mission itself is the requirement.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.verify: Child's Play's mission-complete screen; the trophy pops at once.

steps.t: Play the story until Child's Play appears in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at its end.
It is automatic and unmissable.
It is a story mission, so it appears in the normal mission order and cannot be skipped.
Follow the on-screen objectives; no side preparation is needed.
Official description is simply completing Child's Play, so there is no hidden requirement.
Make a manual save before the mission if you want a clean checkpoint.
Tick it off here as soon as it pops and keep the story moving.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends. Play it when the story offers it; there is no side requirement attached to it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.verify: Headliners' mission-complete screen; the trophy pops at once.

steps.t: Play the story until Headliners appears in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at its end.
It is automatic and unmissable.
It is a story mission, so it appears in the normal mission order and cannot be skipped.
Follow the on-screen objectives; no side preparation is needed.
Official description is simply completing Headliners, so there is no hidden requirement.
Make a manual save before the mission if you want a clean checkpoint.
Tick it off here as soon as it pops and keep the story moving.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the takedown at Vice City International Airport. It pops at the end of the mission. The airport also matters for Catch Me If You Can, so remember the layout here — but that trophy is a separate, later task.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.verify: VCIA Takedown's mission-complete screen; the trophy pops at once.

steps.t: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission at Vice City International Airport; the trophy pops at its end.
It is automatic and unmissable.
It is a story mission, so it appears in the normal mission order and cannot be skipped.
Remember the airport layout here: Catch Me If You Can is a separate, later task at the same airport.
Official description is simply completing VCIA Takedown, so there is no hidden requirement.
Note the departure terminals E3/E4 while you are here — the easiest plane for Catch Me If You Can is docked there.
Tick it off here as soon as it pops and keep the story moving.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends. Like the other named story missions, it is unmissable: play the story in order and it will come.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.verify: Operation Savage Glory's mission-complete screen; the trophy pops at once.

steps.t: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears in Chapter 5.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at its end.
It is automatic and unmissable.
It is a story mission, so it appears in the normal mission order and cannot be skipped.
Follow the on-screen objectives; no side preparation is needed.
Official description is simply completing Operation Savage Glory, so there is no hidden requirement.
Make a manual save before the mission if you want a clean checkpoint.
Tick it off here as soon as it pops; the final mission follows soon after.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears under Progress, then Stats, after the story. This is the longest trophy, around 100 hours of clean-up after a 60-80 hour story, and the hardest on the list. It needs the robbery sets (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), 100 optional tasks, and the collectible sets — KeenGamer lists 15 complete card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 Cocaine Flamingos among them. Do the story first, then work the checklist in the order this guide's roadmap gives, and tick off each part here as it clears.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx and KeenGamer
trophies.verify: Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion reads 100%.

steps.t: Finish the story first; the checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts.
Complete 100 optional missions (purple icons, plus black icons with pink letters); there are far more than 100, and each meditation counts as +2 if done with both characters.
Scan 200 of 277 base vehicle models with WAiNK and study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars.
Finish every robbery set: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults.
Clear the collectible lines: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, 30 of 34 magazines/books/comics.
Clear the activity lines: 300 of 397 stunts, 42 of 42 shooting-range golds, 42 of 42 drone time trials, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 15 Bret's Target Decks.
Clear the money lines: $100,000 narcotics fenced, $100,000 jewelry fenced, $250,000 marked bills fenced, $200,000 vehicles fenced.
The checklist is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and collectibles are only partly required — check the list, not your gut.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps, and there are 397 in total, so you do not need them all — pick the ones near roads and bridges you already travel. Check the in-game stunt counter as you go; a stunt only counts once, so spread them out instead of repeating one spot.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.verify: Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, or the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots.

steps.t: Complete any 250 of 397 stunts; for the 100% checklist you need 300.
Mix the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps — under-the-bridge flights are the quickest.
Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots.
A stunt counts once only, so spread them out instead of repeating one spot.
Use a fast bike or car you already own; stunts near roads and bridges you travel anyway cost no extra time.
Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest to chain: line up a bridge, fly under it, and move to the next one.
Knife flights and base jumps need height and open air — save those for a dedicated session, not mid-mission.
Tick the count off in the tracker here as you pass 100, 200 and 250; the trophy pops at 250.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You do not need to win or finish any of them, just start one of each. Do this during the story as each activity appears, and use the tracker here to see which types are still untried.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.verify: Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities shows all 9 types with at least 1 each.

steps.t: Open Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities to see the 9 types and how many of each you have done.
Try each once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a race, performing a stunt.
You do not need to win or finish any of them, just start one of each.
Most appear naturally while working on other trophies, so do not force it early.
Fishing opens with Cal after Feng Shui in Chapter 1; hunting opens with Bret after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Golf, pool, basketball and the shooting ranges are marked on the map under Activities — filter for them there.
A race counts when you start one; a stunt counts when you complete one, so do the stunt last if you are short.
Check the Activities page after each new try; the trophy pops the moment the ninth type registers.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the 12 shooting ranges. Gold means beating the range's gold score, not just finishing, so learn one range's targets and timing first, then repeat the pattern at the others. Leave this for after the story if you like — the ranges stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.verify: Each range shows its challenges with gold medals; all 42 must be gold.

steps.t: Visit the 12 shooting ranges; there are 42 challenges in total.
Earn a gold medal in every challenge — beat the gold score, not just finish.
Learn one range's targets and timing first, then repeat the pattern at the others.
The ranges stay open in free roam, so leave this for after the story if you like.
Use the weapon the challenge gives you; bringing your own loadout does not change the targets.
Gold scores are shown before you start each challenge — check the target score first, then shoot for it.
If you miss gold, retry at once while the pattern is fresh; there is no penalty for retrying.
Track golds per range in the tracker here; the trophy pops at the 42nd gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is a separate race, so you must win at every one, not just 14 races in total. Learn the drone's controls on the first location, then work through the list one location at a time and tick each off here.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.verify: All 14 Top Fun locations show a win; winning twice at one location does not count twice.

steps.t: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations, with 42 drone races in total.
Win a race at every location — winning at the same location twice does not count twice.
Learn the drone's controls on the first location, then work through the list one at a time.
Drone races are also required for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally in clean-up.
Each location has its own course; learn the turns on a slow first run, then race it for the win.
If you lose a race, retry it at once — the location stays open and there is no cooldown.
Tick each location off in the tracker here as you win it, so you can see which ones are left.
The trophy pops the moment the 14th different location is won.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different means 20 separate race events, so repeating the same race does not add to the count. Try the race types as they appear — road, off-road and water races all count — and keep a note of which ones you have already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.verify: 20 different race events show as won; repeats of one race do not add to the count.

steps.t: There are 40 unique race locations in total.
Win 20 different races; repeating the same race does not add to the count.
Road, off-road and water races all count, so try each type as it appears.
Keep a note of which ones you have already won, and tick them off here.
Use a vehicle suited to the race type — off-road for dirt, a boat for water — instead of forcing one car everywhere.
Races you win during stranger strands, like Yago's, count too, so do those first.
If you lose a race, retry it at once while you know the course.
The trophy pops at the 20th different win; the 100% checklist needs 30 of 40 unique races won.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are one of the activity types, so meet Cal at a fishing spot when the challenge is offered and out-fish him. If you lose, try the challenge again — the trophy is about winning that challenge, not about a single attempt.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.verify: The fishing challenge ends with Cal beaten; retry it if you lose.

steps.t: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you meet Cal, he will send a text marking a fishing location with a purple icon.
Follow Cal's fishing questline to the challenge.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge; if you lose, try it again.
Fishing counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this helps there too.
Bring the best rod and bait you can buy before the challenge; better gear catches faster.
Watch the line tension while reeling — a snapped line loses the fish and the challenge.
The challenge is a single fishing contest, so there is no long quest chain behind it.
Tick it off here when Cal is beaten; the trophy pops at the end of the challenge.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish, at an arcade. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you can finish and play it through once. This also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.verify: The game's end screen after all its levels; you do not need to beat all its challenges.

steps.t: There are 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is at arcade machines around the world.
Finish all levels of one game at least once; you do not need to beat all its challenges.
Pick the shortest game you can finish — any of the four counts.
Play at home on the TV if you want no travel time; the home games count the same.
This also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
If you fail a level, retry it at once; progress within the game is kept per level.
The trophy pops when the final level of your chosen game ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand, through to his final mission. Stranger and side-character strands open as you play and their quest givers can be temporarily unavailable during parts of the story, but PowerPyx reports that all trophy-related quest givers return later, so do not worry if Andy disappears for a while — finish his strand when he is available again, in free roam if needed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.verify: The final mission Puff Puff Pass ends; the trophy pops at once.

steps.t: Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia; while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville.
Complete her 5 quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass.
The final mission is Puff Puff Pass; the trophy pops when it ends.
All quests are still available after the story, so finish the strand in free roam if needed.
Switch to Lucia before starting; the strand is Lucia-only and will not trigger as Jason.
If Andy goes quiet mid-story, keep playing — quest givers return later, and the strand is not missable.
Track the strand under Progress, then Characters, then Andy.
Tick it off here when Puff Puff Pass ends; Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand, through to his final mission. As with the other side characters, Kenton can be temporarily unavailable during the story, and PowerPyx reports that trophy-related quest givers become available again later. Keep playing, check back when his strand reopens, and finish it in free roam if it is still open after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.verify: Kenton's final mission ends; track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.

steps.t: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls you, then is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento.
He offers treasure-diving quests: he marks purple treasure-chest icons, you find the underwater treasures and bring them back, using the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor.
Clear 7 shipwrecks for his questline in total; track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
After Chapter 1 Kenton is temporarily unavailable, then returns in Chapter 2-3, so he is not missable.
Dive with the metal detector equipped; the treasures are buried, not floating in the open water.
Each treasure you return advances the strand; there is no time limit on any of them.
Underwater discoveries from these dives also count toward the 33 needed for the 100% checklist.
Tick it off here when his final mission ends; Kenton's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand, through to his final mission. Billy's strand is one of the side-character strands, so work it when it appears and return to it when the character is available again. It is not a story mission, so it will not pop on its own from playing the main chapters.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.verify: The final mission Hometown Heroes ends; the trophy pops at once.

steps.t: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete his 5 quests in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, then Hometown Heroes.
The final mission is Hometown Heroes; the trophy pops when it ends.
All his quests are still available after the story.
Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub marker when it appears; the strand will not come to you.
If Billy goes quiet mid-story, keep playing — quest givers return later, and the strand is not missable.
Track the strand under Progress, then Characters, then Billy.
Tick it off here when Hometown Heroes ends; Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. A strand is a full chain for one stranger, not a single meeting, so finish each chain to its end before counting it. There are more than 8 strangers in the game, so pick the strands that open earliest and finish those first; the rest can wait for free roam.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.verify: 8 full stranger strands finished to their ends; a single meeting does not count.

steps.t: Only certain questlines count as strangers: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy.

Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and his deliveries).
Finish 8 strands to their ends; a single meeting does not count.
All strangers are still there after the story, so finish them in free roam; track the count in the trophy list.
Start with the strands that open earliest — Kirk, Kyle and Yago open in the early chapters.
Each strand has several missions; a strand only counts when its final mission ends.
If a stranger goes quiet, keep playing the story — strands reopen as chapters pass.
Tick each finished strand off in the tracker here; the trophy pops at the eighth.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand, through to his final mission. Randy is a side character, so his strand runs beside the story rather than in it. If he is unavailable for a stretch, keep playing — PowerPyx reports that trophy-related quest givers return — and finish his final mission when the strand reopens.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.verify: The final delivery of the 16-car wish list is done; track it under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List.

steps.t: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, when you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner.
He then gives you a list of 16 sports cars he wants; track them under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List.
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to see if one is on the list, then steal it and drive it back to his garage in the west of Vice City; delivering it in good condition pays more.
Finish the list; the trophy pops on the final delivery.
The 16 cars are the Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D.
Scan cars as you travel anyway — WAiNK scans also count toward Whip It Good and the 200 vehicles for 100%.
Avoid heavy damage on the drive back; a clean delivery pays more, though a damaged one still counts.
Tick each delivered car off in the tracker here; the trophy pops on the sixteenth.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand, through to his final mission. Tyrone's strand is a side chain, so it needs you to seek him out rather than waiting for the story to bring him to you. Finish it in free roam if it is still open after the final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.verify: The second quest Spin On This ends; the trophy pops at once.

steps.t: Tyrone's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty; it is only available as Jason, not as Lucia.
Go to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City, marked purple, and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter.
After destroying enough labs, Tyrone gives the second quest Spin On This; complete it and the trophy pops.
All of this is still available after the story.
Switch to Jason before starting; the strand is Jason-only and will not trigger as Lucia.
Destroy the labs with explosives or a vehicle — on foot with a pistol is slow and risky.
Track the strand under Progress, then Characters, then Tyrone.
Tick it off here when Spin On This ends; Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. In Chapter 1, after the main mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning: she says she is going to meditate, goes to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation is reported to disappear after Chapter 1, and it is unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — so do it, and do it before Chapter 1 ends. After that, meditate at every marked spot you find; make a manual save at the start of each chapter as a backup, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx and KeenGamer
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx and KeenGamer both report the Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1, but PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — the author had done it when the trophy popped. GTAScoop agrees it is the only possibly missable trophy. Do it to be safe.
trophies.verify: Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations shows the count rising; the balcony meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot.

steps.t: In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony.
Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept when prompted; she shows you how to meditate.
That meditation raises the counter by 1 in the Progress menu, but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest — so it is unconfirmed whether it counts.

Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; you can meditate with Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.
For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18 meditations, and the final one needs both characters together, unlocked after Chapter 2 Coffee Break.
Make a manual save at the start of each chapter as a backup, since there is no mission replay.
Do the balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends — every source agrees it disappears after Chapter 1, and no source confirms it is optional.
Tick each spot off in the tracker here; the trophy pops at the 18th meditation.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Hunting is one of the activity types, so take a hunting trip when Bret's request appears and follow the animal's trail rather than shooting at random wildlife. The animal is unique to this request, so it will not be a common animal you have already hunted. Which animal exactly unlocks this trophy is still unconfirmed — finish Bret's questline and check the trophy after each hunt.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx says Bret's questline is about hunting different animals he requests, and that it is still undergoing confirmation which animal exactly unlocks this trophy. GTAScoop lists it simply as hunting a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.verify: Check the trophy after each hunt in Bret's questline; no source pins down which animal pops it.

steps.t: Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. It is exclusive to Jason.
After that quest he marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to Bret as Jason.
During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations.
It is still unconfirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy, so finish his questline and check the trophy after each hunt.
Hunt the animal Bret marks, not random wildlife — the trophy is for a unique animal he requests.
Use the Killtelligence SM-69 for the hunts; it is the rifle the questline is built around.
Bret's quests also count toward his Target Decks: 15 of 15 are needed for the 100% checklist.
Tick each Bret hunt off in the tracker here and check the trophy after every one.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in total, so you only need 3 of them — pick the sets whose cards you already have most of, and finish those first. Cards are found across Leonida, so collect them as you travel rather than hunting one set at a time from the start.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.verify: The card collection shows 3 complete sets; the 100% checklist needs 15 of 18.

steps.t: There are 18 collectible card sets in total; you only need to complete 3.
Pick the sets whose cards you already have most of, and finish those first.
Cards are found across Leonida, so collect them as you travel rather than hunting one set at a time from the start.
Check the card collection in the Progress menu to see which sets are closest to complete.
Cards hide in shops, houses and landmarks — check inside buildings, not just on the street.
The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past 3 if you want the platinum.
A set counts when its last card is picked up; the trophy pops at the third complete set.
Tick each complete set off in the tracker here.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures across Leonida. Open WAiNK at a landmark and scan it; each new location counts once. Do this as you explore, and save a dedicated sweep for free roam, when you can travel to the landmarks you missed without story missions pulling you away.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.verify: The WAiNK app shows the scanned count; each new location counts once.

steps.t: Scan objects with WAiNK by holding Up and then R1; there are more than 100, so it does not matter which 100 you scan.
The kinds are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags.
Scan as you explore, and save a dedicated sweep for free roam.
WAiNK scans also count toward vehicle discovery and the 100% checklist.
Open WAiNK at a landmark and hold the scan until it registers; a half-scan does not count.
Landmarks cluster in Vice City and the towns, so sweep one region at a time.
The 100% checklist needs 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and the checklist line finish together.
Tick the count off in the tracker here as you pass 25, 50, 75 and 100.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in total, so you need 50 of them, not all 80. Challenges are the small goals listed in the game — stunts, races, activities and more — so many will complete naturally while you work on other trophies. Check the challenge list in free roam and pick off the easiest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.verify: Progress, then Challenges; the Completed checkmark is in the bottom right when scrolling over a challenge.

steps.t: There are 80 challenges in total; you only need 50 for this trophy, and 70 for the 100% checklist.
View and track them under Progress, then Challenges; the Completed checkmark is in the bottom right when scrolling over a challenge.
Many complete naturally while working on other trophies, so leave this for one of your last trophies.
Then pick the easiest and quickest challenges you still have left.
Stunt, race and activity challenges overlap with Cunning Stunts and Earn Cash, Not Kudos — do those first.
Sort the challenge list by progress, not by name, so the nearly-done ones show first.
A challenge only counts when its checkmark shows; a half-finished one does not.
Tick the count off in the tracker here; the trophy pops at the 50th completed challenge.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Do it away from tight streets where police can box you in: get the wanted level up, then drive fast and far, break line of sight, and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Your partner must be with you when the level is lost, so do not start this alone.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.verify: The 4 stars clear while your partner is with you; the trophy pops after you leave the red heat zone.

steps.t: This is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together as Jason and Lucia; call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Cause carnage until you reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic to get out of the search area.
If a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it goes away; the trophy unlocks after you drive out of the red heat zone, not after leaving the flashing search area.
Easiest route: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
You will also get this automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which gives 4-star wanted levels at every large bank vault.
Keep your partner beside you the whole time; if they are left behind, the attempt does not count.
Do it away from tight streets where police can box you in — open roads and the tunnel work best.
If the stars drop to 3, build them back up before escaping; the trophy needs a full 4-star escape.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level — meaning you must keep the wanted level going through all three robberies, not clear it between them. Plan a route past three shops close together, rob them one after another, and keep moving: the trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.verify: The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop; if it does not, one shop did not count.

steps.t: This is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between Jason and Lucia and free-roam together.
Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons on the map) while being chased by police the whole time — the wanted level must not clear between shops.
Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations, and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing, before you start.
A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
Call your partner first by holding Right and pressing Triangle; the robberies must be done together.
Rob each shop quickly and move to the next — lingering in one shop lets the police box you in.
The unlock is delayed: it pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop, and if it does not pop, one of the shops did not count.
Tick it off here when it pops; shop robberies also count toward the 100% checklist's robbery lines.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts when you find it, and a WAiNK scan is reported to be enough to register one, so scan vehicles as you see them instead of only driving them. Work through the vehicle types as you travel, and stand at a busy road to scan the traffic passing by.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.verify: Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles shows the discovered count rising.

steps.t: GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes).
Use the WAiNK app from your phone (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it.
Stand at a busy road and scan all the vehicles passing by; you need 200 base-model scans for the 100% checklist.
Check discovered vehicles under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
Scan every new vehicle you see during the story — the count carries over into free roam.
Boats, helicopters and planes count too, so scan them at marinas and airfields, not just cars on the road.
A vehicle only counts once, so a busy road with new models is better than the same street twice.
Tick the count off in the tracker here as you pass 25, 50, 75 and 100.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped together, activate Combat Focus, and take them down before it ends. Do not waste it on a lone enemy — pick a busy shootout, ideally at a gang operation, and buff your focus first.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.verify: 5 enemies down inside one Combat Focus use; the trophy pops when the fifth falls.

steps.t: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm; it slows time and highlights vulnerable points.
Buff your focus first: eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and consume Adrenaline before the fight.
Line up 5 enemies (criminals at gang operations work) and defeat them quickly without missing.
It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, and it gets easier at Focus Level 2, unlocked by the mission A Walk in the Park.
Pick a gang operation with enemies grouped together; a lone enemy wastes the whole Focus bar.
Use an assault rifle for the attempt — it drops grouped enemies faster than a pistol.
If you run out of Focus with enemies left, retreat, re-buff, and try again at the next operation.
Tick it off here when the fifth enemy falls inside one Focus use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave the airport in an aircraft that was not scheduled to depart, in your own way. This is a stunt-style trophy at the airport, so take a plane or helicopter, get it moving, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.verify: Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the unlock is a little delayed.

steps.t: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA — it must be a plane that was not scheduled to depart.
The easiest plane is the one at departure terminals E3/E4; drive through a fence around the airport to reach it.
Inside the plane go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, then take off.
Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the unlock is a little delayed.
Expect a wanted level at the airport — take off fast and do not stop to fight the police on the runway.
A helicopter also counts as an unscheduled departure, but a plane is easier to fly far enough.
Remember the airport layout from the VCIA Takedown story mission; the terminals are the same ones.
Tick it off here when the trophy pops after you are 1 km clear of VCIA.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank and use it. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive in through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a Rhino tank, fire its cannon and drive around until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx and GTAScoop
trophies.verify: Fire the tank cannon and drive around the base; the trophy pops in about 25 seconds inside the tank.

steps.t: Steal a military tank — GTAScoop lists this as stealing a military tank, and PowerPyx names the Rhino at Mile Zero Air Station.
Find the tanks at Mile Zero Air Station, the island in the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base.
Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance.

Approach the south-east entrance, go around the barricades, turn right at the yellow barrier, use the dirt ramp to jump a truck over the perimeter fence, then break through an inner fence to reach the unlocked Rhino tanks.
Enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.
Fire the cannon for a few seconds and drive around the base; the trophy pops in about 25 seconds inside the tank.
The tank has a military tracker, so the police will keep finding you while you are in it — that is normal.
Tick it off here when the trophy pops; you can do this from Chapter 1, right after Jason's first mission.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: plan the entry, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt does not count — leave and try again. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silent entry.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.verify: Leave the store with the loot and no alarm raised; being spotted fails the attempt.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; it unlocks the Snap Gun for silent entry.
Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory.
Enter the back room, look for a note with the safe code, and use the code to loot the safe.
A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City; if you are spotted, the attempt does not count.
Move slowly inside and stay out of the cameras and the staff's line of sight.
Take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm — speed matters less than silence.
If the alarm goes off, leave at once and try again; the store resets.
Tick it off here when you leave with the loot undetected.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, five times. This needs the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', after which you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open — that is the route PowerPyx and KeenGamer describe. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; you need any 5 for this trophy, but all 8 for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.verify: 5 bank vaults robbed and escaped; each vault robbery gives a 4-star wanted level.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe); it unlocks bank vault robberies.
Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase with cash into the vault — follow him in while it is open.
After the quest, pay Yasmani for tips about security vans ($10,000 a tip, after his earlier jobs) to find the next vault.
Robbing a bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia if you can.
There are 8 large bank jobs in total; you need any 5 for this trophy, but all 8 for the 100% checklist.
Each vault robbery also counts toward Hot Together if your partner is with you when you escape.
Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, which also helps Dime on the Dollar.
Tick each vault off in the tracker here; the trophy pops after the fifth escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo, and get away before the police close in. Plan your escape route before you start the robbery, so you are driving away while the police are still arriving. The trophy unlocks only after escaping the red heat radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.verify: The trophy unlocks only after escaping the red heat radius.

steps.t: This is unlocked automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, where you tail an armored truck to a bank.
Tail the truck, wait for the guard to carry the cash to the vault, enter quickly, steal the cash and leave.
To do it earlier, find an armored truck driving around Vice City near banks, block its path and stop it.
The trophy unlocks only after escaping the red heat radius.
Plan your escape route before you start — a fast motorcycle or car parked nearby saves the attempt.
Armored trucks also appear as part of the bank-job route, so this often pops while working on Maximum Withdrawal.
Do not stop to fight the police at the truck; take the cash and drive.
Tick it off here when it pops after you clear the heat radius.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida, clearing the fog from the whole map. Travel to every region, and fly over the dark patches on the map — PowerPyx reports that flying over them is the quickest way to clear them. Do this in free roam after the story, when nothing pulls you back to a mission area.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.verify: The whole map is visible with no black fog left; the trophy pops when the last patch clears.

steps.t: Fully unfog the whole map; this is best done using a plane.
Fly over all the areas with black fog on the map until the entire map becomes visible.
Do this in free roam after the story, when nothing pulls you back to a mission area.
Leonida has six regions — Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga — and every one must be cleared.
The map starts covered; exploring clears it, and flying is the fastest way to clear the last patches.
Drive and fly through each region in turn instead of circling one city — the fog only clears where you have been.
The trophy pops as soon as the last patch of fog is gone.
Tick it off here when the map is fully clear; exploring also finds WAiNK locations and vehicles on the way.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang, nine in total. Gang operations are part of the 100% checklist too, so work them as you work toward A Long Road: find each gang's operation, rob it, loot everything, and fence the loot. For the checklist you need all 39 operations, so this trophy is the first step of a much longer job.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.verify: Progress, then Gangs shows at least 1 operation robbed for each of the 9 gangs.

steps.t: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations in total.
Rob one operation belonging to each gang; for the 100% checklist you need all 39, so this trophy is the start, not the end.
Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked by the gang's own icons.
Track them under Progress, then Gangs; scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
Loot everything at each operation — key valuables, unique weapons, luxury watches and safe cash all count.
Fence the loot after each operation; you need $100,000 in narcotics fenced for the 100% checklist.
Clear the operation fully: an operation only counts when all its key valuables are collected.
Tick each gang off in the tracker here; the trophy pops at the ninth gang.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach and drink a cocktail with a view. GTAScoop names the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, but PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so the exact bar is disputed — go to the rooftop bar GTAScoop names first, and if it does not pop, try other bars with a view on Ocean Beach and check the trophy after each one.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.dispute: GTAScoop names the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so the exact bar is not confirmed. Try the rooftop bar first, then other Ocean Beach bars.
trophies.verify: Check the trophy after each bar; no source confirms which bar pops it.

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, the bar GTAScoop names.
Order and enjoy a cocktail with the view there.
PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so if the rooftop bar does not pop it, try other bars with a view on Ocean Beach.
The trophy is about the cocktail and the view together, not just drinking anywhere.
Check the trophy after each bar you try, so you know which one worked.
Ocean Beach is in Vice City, so go there in free roam when you are in the city anyway.
Do not chase a specific trigger until a source pins it down — the rooftop bar is the best lead, not a confirmed method.
Tick it off here only when the trophy actually pops, not when you think it should have.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom's frontage and out onto the street. GTAScoop reports this as smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, so the exact showroom is not pinned down — try a showroom in Vice City with a fast car, and check the trophy after each attempt.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.dispute: GTAScoop says smash out of a vehicle showroom. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so the exact showroom and method are not confirmed.
trophies.verify: Check the trophy after each attempt; no source confirms which showroom pops it.

steps.t: Pick a vehicle showroom in Vice City and take a fast car inside it.
Drive the car straight through the showroom's frontage and out onto the street, in classic style.
PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so the exact showroom is not pinned down — try another showroom if the first does not pop it.
Use a fast, heavy car so you break through the frontage in one run instead of stopping inside.
Check the trophy after each attempt, so you know which showroom worked.
Showrooms are in Vice City's dealership districts; pick one with a wide glass front.
Do not chase a specific trigger until a source pins it down — the showroom smash is the best lead, not a confirmed method.
Tick it off here only when the trophy actually pops.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the gang operations in Port Gellhorn. Before going there, buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations — you need them to destroy the safe. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, so keep moving once you have all three.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.verify: All 3 valuables stolen and the police escaped; the trophy pops after the escape, not at the third pickup.

steps.t: Go during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, marked automatically; Kingpin Bowling is in Port Gellhorn.
Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations first — you need them to destroy the safe.
Steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gator X, and the safe cash.
The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item; killing the gang members first helps.
If you do not get all 3 in the mission, wait until the robbery icon respawns, then go back for the missing ones.
This is also a gang operation, so it counts toward Pest Control and the 39 operations for 100%.
Use the sticky bombs on the safe only — shooting it wastes time while the police arrive.
Tick it off here when the trophy pops after the escape.

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then scroll to Strength. Work out together with both characters — while one works out, the other completes a quick workout too — and keep going until both bars are full at once.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.verify: Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength shows maximum for both characters at the same time.

steps.t: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.
This is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two characters.
Increase strength by working out; buy a membership at a fitness club, and filter for fitness activities on the map.
Always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner) so both gain strength.
Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then scroll to Strength (heart icon); you need both bars full at once.
Alternate workouts between the two characters so neither bar falls while the other rises.
Gyms are in Vice City and the towns; pick one near your current mission to save travel.
Tick it off here when both strength bars show maximum at the same time.

trophies.guide: Make choices that affect your Criminal Profile — PSNProfiles tracks a count to 500 for this trophy. Choices are the small decisions the game records as you play: how you handle jobs, people and the law. Play normally through the story and side content, and the count climbs on its own; turn on Criminal Profile notifications so you can see it rising.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.verify: The Criminal Profile count reaches 500; view it by clicking the trophy in the list.

steps.t: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile; view the count by clicking the trophy in the list.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, so you see the count rise.
Actions range from Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes) to Reckless and Irredeemable.
It happens passively while working on other trophies; every robbery and enemy encounter counts.
Avoid the Irredeemable profile if you can: it is permanent and makes the police more aggressive.
Stealthy play and clean escapes push the profile toward Professional, which is the safer path.
Do not grind this on its own — let it finish while you work the checklist and stranger strands.
Tick it off here when the count reaches 500; the trophy pops at once.

Do not chase a specific trigger until a source pins it down — play through the Payday Loans content, check the trophy after each visit, and treat the prologue store as a lead, not a confirmed method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx believes this is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. GTAScoop lists this trophy as not known yet. No source confirms a trigger.

GTAScoop lists this trophy as not known yet.
Until a source confirms it, do not chase a specific trigger; play the Payday Loans content in the story and free roam.
The description says second time's the charm, which fits returning to a place a second time — but no source confirms what place.
Check the trophy after each Payday Loans visit, so you know if one of them popped it.
Payday Loans jobs are part of the 100% checklist (7 jobs), so do those anyway and watch for the pop.
If it pops, note what you just did — that is the first confirmed report of the trigger.
Tick it off here only when the trophy actually pops.

Keep an eye on the sky and on unusual landmarks while you travel for other trophies.
If it pops, note what you just saw — that is the first confirmed report of the trigger.

The description says a melee drive-by, so get a melee weapon, drive past a target at speed, and strike them as you pass — but treat the motorcycle-kick lead as a lead, not a confirmed method, and check the trophy after each attempt.

steps.t: PowerPyx believes this is from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — treat that as a lead, not a confirmed method.
GTAScoop lists this trophy as not known yet.
The description says a melee drive-by: get a melee weapon, drive past a target at speed, and strike them as you pass.
Try it on a motorcycle first, since that is the lead PowerPyx gives.
Pick a target standing still, like a pedestrian on a quiet road, so the pass is clean.
Do not use a gun for this attempt — the trophy is about a melee strike, not a shot.
If it pops, note the vehicle and weapon you used — that is the first confirmed report of the trigger.
Tick it off here only when the trophy actually pops.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, and contacts launder them for you for a cut — use your contacts regularly after each robbery instead of letting the bills pile up. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but only after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.verify: $250,000 in marked bills laundered in total, across all robberies.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew); it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering Marked Bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays a good rate.
Deliver a total of $250,000 in marked bills to a fence; it counts across all robberies, not in one trip.
Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but only after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.
Launder after every robbery instead of letting bills pile up; the counter only moves when you deliver them.
The 100% checklist also needs $250,000 marked bills fenced, so this trophy and that line finish together.
Check the laundered total under Progress, then Money, as you deliver.
Tick it off here when the total reaches $250,000; the trophy pops at once.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, in total. Buy weapons, clothes, food and other shop goods as you play — the counter is cumulative across every shop, so normal spending adds up. If you are close at the end, buy the most expensive useful items you still need, like car mods or tattoos.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.verify: $100,000 spent in total across all shops; the counter is cumulative.

steps.t: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops; the counter is cumulative.
Buying guns, car mods and tattoos is the fastest method, as these are the most expensive.
Shops include 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 food and drink spots, and more.
If you are close at the end, buy the most expensive useful items you still need.
Normal spending during the story already counts, so this often pops on its own.
Car mods at a mod shop are the biggest single purchases — one full mod set can be tens of thousands.
Check the spent total under Progress, then Money, as you shop.
Tick it off here when the total reaches $100,000.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are properties you buy, so save money for them and buy each one as it becomes available. There are 8 in total, and buying them also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect — and each garage adds parking for the Scooter Bros registrations in On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.verify: All 8 purchasable garages bought; story garages do not count toward the 8.

steps.t: There are 8 purchasable garages and 4 story-related garages; you only need the 8 purchasable ones.
Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses).
Buy the garages through the phone app.
A quick way to make money is robberies, especially later in Chapters 3-4 when higher-value targets open up.
Buy each garage as soon as you can afford it, instead of saving for all 8 at once.
Each garage adds one or more parking spaces, which you need for On the Spot registrations.
Check the owned properties under the phone app to see which garages are still unbought.
Tick it off here when the eighth garage is bought.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until 10 are registered. Use different vehicles, not the same one ten times, and register them cheaply: use low-end cars and bikes, since registering costs money.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.verify: 10 different vehicles registered in the Scooter Bros app.

steps.t: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Meeting).
You must buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes); each garage adds one or more parking spaces.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray and Register.
Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register tracked vehicles.
Register 10 different vehicles; registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
WAiNK-scan cars first to check if they are on Randy's wish list — a listed car is worth more delivered to Randy.
Check the registered count in the Scooter Bros app as you go.
Tick it off here when the tenth different vehicle is registered.
